    intro T
    constructor
    · intro hT hTc
      have h := hPP T hT Tᶜ hTc
      simpa using h
    · intro hTc
      by_contra hT
      have hex : ∃ U ∈ P, T ∩ U = ∅ := by
        by_contra hn
        push_neg at hn
        exact hPS ⟨T, hT, hn⟩
      rcases hex with ⟨U, hU, hTU⟩
      apply hTc
      apply hup hU
